claim: The Direct Connect FAQ says AWS Direct Connect has two separate charges, port hours and data transfer; pricing is per port-hour consumed for each port type, partial port hours are billed as full hours, and the account that owns the port is charged the port-hour charges. Since September 15, 2026 Direct Connect also supports flat-rate billing, a fixed-price billing mode for dedicated connections that you set per connection.

evidence.quote: AWS Direct Connect has two separate charges: port hours and data transfer. Pricing is per port-hour consumed for each port type. Partial port hours consumed are billed as full hours. The account that owns the port will be charged the port hour charges.

| [Flat-rate billing for dedicated connections](#AboutThisGuide) | Direct Connect now supports flat-rate billing, a fixed-price billing mode for dedicated connections that you set per connection. For more information, see [Flat-rate billing for dedicated connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/directconnect/latest/UserGuide/flat-rate-connections.html). | September 15, 2026 |
